decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a core part of the firm's automation strategy for precast plants, and products like this have long sales cycles, so dropping it after one year would be premature.
The de-shuttering robot complements the firm's established circulation plant offer and is sold as a modular part of integrated lines, so it is likely to be kept.
The profile storage robot supports automated shuttering workflows and plant standardization, adding value to integrated solutions at low marginal cost.
Automatic shuttering robots are central to future-ready automated precast production, matching the firm's strategic direction and growing demand for housing construction.
